column8: ["Material richness is thin: the plum housing reads as softly shaded plastic, while the brown inset between the seats reads as muddy fill rather than rubbed brass. Sharpen the material differences and concentrate wear at contact edges.","Bright upper rims and dark lower edges give the housing and seat collars directional lighting. Use symmetric tonal shaping so the object remains convincing when rotated.","The painting lacks distinctive craft: broad, blurred bevels dominate, with little purposeful surface detail to reward a closer look. Give the glaze and metal clearer, characterful finishes."]
